Acer Aspire Go 16 AG16-71P-96TX
Make more room for work, study and everyday entertainment with the Acer Aspire Go 16. This configuration combines an Intel Core 9 270H processor, 16GB DDR5 memory and fast 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD storage with a spacious 16-inch WUXGA display.
16-inch WUXGA display
The 16-inch IPS screen offers WUXGA resolution (1920 × 1200) and a 120Hz refresh rate. Its 16:10 format provides extra vertical space for documents, spreadsheets and browsing.
Performance for your daily workload
The Intel Core 9 270H processor works with 16GB DDR5 memory, installed as two 8GB modules. A 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD gives you responsive storage for your files and applications. Graphics are handled by the processor's integrated Intel graphics; this model does not have a dedicated graphics card.
Built for everyday use
Connect using Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth, and join video calls with the Full HD webcam. The laptop comes in Pure Silver with a 53Wh battery and a 65W USB-C power adapter.

Acer Nitro V 16S ANV16S-71-76PU
Play, create and multitask on the Acer Nitro V 16S. This specific configuration pairs an Intel Core 7 240H processor with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU, 16GB DDR5 memory and a sharp 16-inch WQXGA display with a 180Hz refresh rate.
RTX 5070 graphics for gaming and creative work
The NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU has 8GB of GDDR7 graphics memory. Acer lists up to 85W maximum graphics power including Dynamic Boost for the Nitro V 16S series. Graphics performance depends on the game, settings and operating conditions.
16-inch WQXGA 180Hz display
The 16-inch IPS display combines WQXGA resolution (2560 × 1600), a 16:10 aspect ratio and a 180Hz refresh rate. NVIDIA G-SYNC support helps deliver smoother visuals in compatible games.
Memory, storage and cooling
With 16GB DDR5 memory installed as one 16GB module and a 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD, this laptop is ready for games and everyday applications. The Nitro V 16S design uses a dual-fan cooling system and includes a four-zone RGB backlit keyboard.
Connectivity and everyday essentials
Connect through Killer Wi-Fi 6 or wired Gigabit Ethernet. The laptop also includes Bluetooth, a microSD card reader, an HD webcam, HDMI, three USB-A ports and a USB-C port. It comes with a 76Wh battery, 135W power adapter and Windows 11 Home Single Language.
